stories.summary: Add Toggle Control for Skeleton Overlay Visibility

details.user_story: As a user, I want to toggle the skeleton overlay on and off during video playback, so I can choose whether to view the pose analysis or just the raw video.
details.context: Currently, the skeleton overlay is always visible when analysis results are available. Users may want to compare their swing with and without the overlay, or simply prefer viewing the raw video without visual annotations.
acceptance_criteria: A toggle button/switch is visible in the UI when analysis results are loaded.
Clicking the toggle hides/shows the skeleton overlay without affecting video playback.
Toggle state persists during video scrubbing and seeking.
Overlay visibility preference is maintained when switching between analyzed videos in the same session.
Toggle is disabled or hidden when no analysis results are available.
technical_details: Add a boolean state variable (e.g., `showOverlay`) in App.js.
Conditionally render the SkeletonOverlay component based on this state.
Add a toggle button (likely near playback controls) that updates the state.
Ensure the toggle doesn't trigger unnecessary re-renders of the video player.
edge_cases: Toggle should be disabled during video upload/processing (no results yet).
Switching videos should reset or maintain toggle state (decide on UX preference).
Toggle state should not interfere with overlay synchronization logic.
Consider accessibility: toggle should have proper ARIA labels for screen readers.
